title: Decide one rule for whether an Engram admission Stop drops later queued workflow continuations
outcome: From the round-3 review of w-f917452faa71 (Claude delegation-8250851e, Low, src/session_stop_idle_wait.rs). With no pending wait, the Engram admission/retry Stop keeps later Orchestrator continuations queued behind the latch, so they run on an explicit Resume. With any pending delegation or test-run wait, the same Stop now also drops them (it keeps the Engram-held head). The running-Stop path always drops them. Decide one rule: always drop non-held Orchestrator continuations on an admission Stop, or never. Then test the no-wait case explicitly.
acceptance: Decide one rule for whether an Engram admission Stop drops later queued workflow continuations is done
